long_description: Hakim Device connects ChatGPT to an Android device that the user owns or is authorized to manage. The public plugin intentionally exposes only a narrow set of device actions: check whether the paired device is online, open an explicitly selected app or HTTP/HTTPS link, navigate Home/Back/Recents, and check the status of a requested operation. Every state-changing action remains behind Android approval. The public plugin does not expose shell, root, raw screenshots, notifications, arbitrary typing, or general tap/swipe control. It does not require an OpenAI API key; ChatGPT remains the conversation and reasoning layer while Hakim is the authorized execution bridge.
starter_prompts: Check whether my paired Hakim device is online.
Open Chrome on my paired Hakim device.
Go back once on my paired Hakim device.
